notes.title: The second enemy character's attribute value was modified.
notes.content:
This modification is for the full version only.

This game had an issue that the specific phenomenon rarely occur.
The specific phenomenon is a hint to consider the game rules.
Therefore, I modified the second enemy character's attribute value to make the specific phenomenon easier to occur.
The details is following.
Before: 172 → After: 79

If you have saved the game in just front of the second enemy character before the update of this time,
The number of previous attribute value is referred even though after the update.
Putting down the "Reset Game" key once or moving to another area makes the new attribute value effective.

The previous specifications prioritize the rationality and reality of the enemy characters behavior.
However, I have supposed that the game should prioritize more the understandability and rewarding to entertain dear players since checking some of their comments out on social media.
This modification is for improving the understandability.
The release date of the next update is not decided yet.

The footage of the specific phenomenon have been published on the external site.
The footage's title is "S | 攻略のヒントその７ | Hints for clearing the game No.7".
You can access the page have the footage from the Q&A page.
Please click the "View the manual" link button to access the Q&A page.

[b]Other modifications in this time[/b]
The message texts appearing when the save data is broken were modified.

notes.title: Demo version | Modified the threshold of unlocking the door
notes.content:
The specifications regarding the threshold of unlocking the door was different between the demo version and the full version.
The differences was a hindrance to create gameplay hints.
And, I decided removing the differences.
The full version is not changed in this time.

[b]Change Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] The threshold value of unlocking the door rose.
[*] The expected value of random numbers presented by enemy characters rose also.
[/list]


The hints page is in an external site.
If you interested in it, Refer Q&A page linked the "View the manual" button in the store page.
